defmodule ChatServer.WebSocket do
  @behaviour :cowboy_websocket

  alias ChatServer.{RateLimiter, SessionStore, TokenVerifier}

  @max_retries 3
  @retry_delay_ms 100
  @heartbeat_interval 30_000

  def init(req, state) do
    peer = :cowboy_req.peer(req)
    headers = :cowboy_req.headers(req)
    origin = Map.get(headers, "origin", "")
    token = extract_token(req)

    case authenticate_connection(req, token, peer, origin) do
      {:ok, session} ->
        ws_state = %{
          session: session,
          peer: peer,
          origin: origin,
          rate_limiter: RateLimiter.new(peer),
          retry_count: 0,
          authenticated: true
        }
        {:cowboy_websocket, req, ws_state, %{idle_timeout: @heartbeat_interval}}

      {:error, reason} ->
        req2 = :cowboy_req.reply(403, %{"content-type" => "text/plain"}, reason, req)
        {:ok, req2, state}
    end
  end

  defp authenticate_connection(req, token, peer, origin) do
    with :ok <- verify_origin(origin, req),
         {:ok, claims} <- TokenVerifier.verify(token),
         {:ok, session} <- SessionStore.get_or_create(claims["sub"]) do
      {:ok, session}
    else
      {:error, :origin_mismatch} -> {:error, "Origin not allowed"}
      {:error, :invalid_token} -> {:error, "Invalid token"}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, "Auth failed: #{inspect(reason)}"}
    end
  end

  defp verify_origin(origin, req) do
    host = :cowboy_req.host(req)
    allowed_origins = Application.get_env(:chat_server, :allowed_origins, [])
    request_origin = URI.parse(origin)

    cond do
      origin == "" -> {:error, :origin_mismatch}
      request_origin.host == host -> :ok
      origin in allowed_origins -> :ok
      true -> {:error, :origin_mismatch}
    end
  end

  defp extract_token(req) do
    qs = :cowboy_req.parse_qs(req)
    case List.keyfind(qs, "token", 0) do
      {"token", token} -> token
      nil ->
        headers = :cowboy_req.headers(req)
        case Map.get(headers, "sec-websocket-protocol", "") do
          "" -> nil
          protocols ->
            protocols
            |> String.split(",")
            |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
            |> Enum.find(&String.starts_with?(&1, "auth."))
            |> case do
              nil -> nil
              "auth." <> token -> token
            end
        end
    end
  end

  def websocket_handle({:text, msg}, state) do
    case RateLimiter.check(state.rate_limiter) do
      {:ok, limiter} ->
        state = %{state | rate_limiter: limiter, retry_count: 0}
        handle_message(msg, state)

      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        if state.retry_count < @max_retries do
          Process.send_after(self(), {:retry, msg}, @retry_delay_ms)
          {[], %{state | retry_count: state.retry_count + 1}}
        else
          frame = {:text, Jason.encode!(%{error: "rate_limited", retry_after: 5})}
          {[frame], %{state | retry_count: 0}}
        end
    end
  end

  def websocket_handle({:ping, data}, state) do
    {[{:pong, data}], state}
  end

  def websocket_handle(_frame, state), do: {[], state}

  def websocket_info({:retry, msg}, state) do
    websocket_handle({:text, msg}, state)
  end

  def websocket_info({:broadcast, payload}, state) do
    frame = {:text, Jason.encode!(payload)}
    {[frame], state}
  end

  def websocket_info(:heartbeat, state) do
    {[{:ping, <<>>}], state}
  end

  def websocket_info(_info, state), do: {[], state}

  defp handle_message(raw, state) do
    case Jason.decode(raw) do
      {:ok, %{"type" => "subscribe", "channel" => channel}} ->
        ChatServer.PubSub.subscribe(channel, state.session.user_id)
        frame = {:text, Jason.encode!(%{type: "subscribed", channel: channel})}
        {[frame], state}

      {:ok, %{"type" => "publish", "channel" => channel, "data" => data}} ->
        payload = %{from: state.session.user_id, channel: channel, data: data}
        ChatServer.PubSub.broadcast(channel, {:broadcast, payload})
        {[], state}

      {:ok, %{"type" => "ping"}} ->
        frame = {:text, Jason.encode!(%{type: "pong", ts: System.system_time(:millisecond)})}
        {[frame], state}

      _ ->
        frame = {:text, Jason.encode!(%{error: "invalid_message"})}
        {[frame], state}
    end
  end
end

defmodule ChatServer.TokenVerifier do
  @secret Application.compile_env(:chat_server, :jwt_secret) ||
            raise("chat_server :jwt_secret must be configured; refusing to start with a default secret")

  def verify(nil), do: {:error, :invalid_token}
  def verify(""), do: {:error, :invalid_token}

  def verify(token) do
    case JOSE.JWT.verify_strict(@secret, ["HS256"], token) do
      {true, %{fields: claims}, _} ->
        case claims["exp"] do
          exp when is_integer(exp) and exp > System.system_time(:second) ->
            {:ok, claims}

          exp when is_integer(exp) ->
            {:error, :token_expired}

          _ ->
            {:error, :invalid_token}
        end

      _ ->
        {:error, :invalid_token}
    end
  end
end

defmodule ChatServer.RateLimiter do
  @window_ms 1_000
  @max_messages 10

  defstruct [:peer, :window_start, :count]

  def new(peer) do
    %__MODULE__{peer: peer, window_start: now(), count: 0}
  end

  def check(%__MODULE__{} = limiter) do
    current = now()

    if current - limiter.window_start > @window_ms do
      {:ok, %{limiter | window_start: current, count: 1}}
    else
      if limiter.count < @max_messages do
        {:ok, %{limiter | count: limiter.count + 1}}
      else
        {:error, :rate_limited}
      end
    end
  end

  defp now, do: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
end
